parsed_json.up: Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism, compound_records (substrate), compound_structures (substrate), molecule_dictionary (parent). Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records_substr.record_id; compound_records_substr.molregno = molecule_dictionary_substr.molregno; molecule_dictionary_substr.molregno = compound_structures_substr.molregno; metabolism.drug_record_id = compound_records_parent.record_id; compound_records_parent.molregno = molecule_dictionary_parent.molregno. Filter: metabolism.organism = 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_compound_name ASC, parent_compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC, organism ASC, enzyme_name ASC. Limit: 200.
